Paragraph: "Keep your intellect and wisdom firm, and express all your intents rightly in your body language in all your undertakings... certainly, a king getting into unintelligence cannot command all his subjects..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Breakdown of leadership intelligence and non-verbal congruence under stress.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma advises firm intellect, confident posture (Ingita), and executive self-possession.
Outcome/Resolution: He lays out essential emotional intelligence principles for leadership.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Executive Functioning, Somatic Congruence, Leadership Poise

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Buddhi-Sthirata (Steadfastness of intellect required for leadership and governance)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: A leader must operate from higher intellect (Buddhi) rather than reactive lower emotions to guide others.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Executive regulation and non-verbal alignment: maintaining cognitive clarity and confident body language under stress.
